topic: Matrix Multiplication as Composition of Linear Transformations

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: The Linear Transformation
lecture_lines: A matrix acts as a transformation function.
Vectors change position through these functions.
We visualize grid distortions by matrices.

sections.title: The Concept of Composition
lecture_lines: Sequence two transformations for complex results.
Apply transformation B then apply A.
animations: Introduce function f (blue #4169E1) and g (green #32CD32) using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg].

sections.title: Deriving the Matrix Product
lecture_lines: This equals the matrix product AB.
AB captures the combined transformation instruction.
animations: Display vectors A and B as matrices with #FFFFFF.

lecture_lines: Applying B then A yields another.
